system_prompt: You are an expert computational medicinal chemist. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Addition of an electron-withdrawing trifluoromethyl group to the aromatic ring to increase reactivity of the alkylating group and enhance DNA interaction.
modifications.rationale: The trifluoromethyl group is highly electron-withdrawing, which can increase the electrophilicity of the alkylating centers, potentially enhancing DNA alkylation.

modifications.description: Introduction of a methyl group ortho to the nitrogen substituent on the aromatic ring to improve selectivity by steric hindrance.
modifications.rationale: The methyl group provides steric hindrance, which may help in orienting the molecule favorably for selective interactions with DNA.

modifications.description: Replacement of one chloroethyl group with a bromoethyl group to modify alkylation reactivity and enhance potency.
modifications.rationale: The bromoethyl group is more reactive compared to chloroethyl, which can potentially enhance alkylation efficiency and potency.

modifications.description: Incorporation of a hydroxymethyl substituent on the aromatic ring to increase solubility and potentially improve DNA binding through hydrogen bonding.
modifications.rationale: The hydroxymethyl group can engage in hydrogen bonding with DNA, improving binding interactions, while also increasing the compound's aqueous solubility.

modifications.description: Substitution of the carboxylic acid group with a carbamate moiety to enhance stability and reduce off-target effects.
modifications.rationale: The carbamate group can provide better metabolic stability and reduced reactivity compared to the carboxylic acid, potentially decreasing off-target alkylation.
